name: HyperSaw
tagline: Three layers of JP-8000 style supersaw in one oscillator. Each layer has 7 detuned voices and its own waveform, for trance and hardstyle leads.
screen_note: The xd shows typeless parameters (Wave A, B and C) one higher than the number the code uses, so they read 1 to 10. Oct B, Oct C and Layer Bal show a percent sign.

knobs.name: SHAPE
knobs.what: Detune, JP-8000 curve. The xd's LFO and mod routing can sweep it.

knobs.name: SHIFT + SHAPE
knobs.what: Mix: centre voice against the 6 side voices.

params.Wave B: Waveform of layer B (1 = layer off).
params.Wave C: Waveform of layer C (1 = layer off).
params.Oct B: Octave of layer B against layer A. The screen shows %, read it as octaves.
params.Oct C: Octave of layer C against layer A. The screen shows %, read it as octaves.
params.Layer Bal: -100% = only layer A, 0% = equal, +100% = only layers B and C.

notes: If all three layers are Off (screen 1), layer A plays Supersaw so you never get silence.
starters: Classic JP lead: Wave A 2 (Supersaw), Wave B 1, Wave C 1, Shape about 60%, Shift+Shape about 70%.
Hypersaw: Wave A 2, Wave B 2 with Oct B -1, Wave C 2 with Oct C +1, Layer Bal 0.
Trance pad: Wave A 2, Wave B 3 (Square) with Oct B -1, Wave C 8 (Glass 1) with Oct C +1, Layer Bal -30.
Hardstyle Ah lead: Wave A 10 (Vox Ah), Wave B 2, Wave C 3 (Square) with Oct C -1, Layer Bal -20, Shape about 70%, Shift+Shape about 60%, short decay, sustain about 35%.
Pure choir: Wave A 10 only, Shape about 25%, slow attack.
problems: 3 layers x 7 voices x 4 notes is the heavy case. If it crackles or drops out, set Wave C to 1 (Off) first, then Wave B.
status: Version 1.3. The unit in dist/ was built from this repo's source and its manifest matches manifest.json.
No test on a real minilogue xd is recorded in this repo yet. Treat it as a test build and tell us what you hear.
